verdict.rationale: Rainforest's first-party docs describe a dedicated sandbox environment with documented test cards and test bank accounts that produce deterministic outcomes such as approved or declined payments. The marketing site advertises 'full end-to-end sandbox testing', and the going-live guide frames integration in phases before production. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that sandbox credentials and data are isolated from production (for example, separate API keys or base URLs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox workflow.
